name: Mat. Murphy
role: Of Murphy Bros., superintended cattle delivery
mentions: …[brand symbol] bar cattle were delivered to the N. P. Ref. Car Co. last Sunday morning, averaging 1089½. Mat. Murphy superintended the delivery.
Last Sunday's delivery completed the Murphy Bros. contract with the Co. 2,500 head have been delivered averaging a little over 1090. Mat. and Billy Murphy left for the west Monday.
